encoding_and_ranges.packet_hash: sha256 of utf8_text encoded as UTF-8 exactly, including its final newline; do not reserialize first
encoding_and_ranges.source_hash: sha256 of the complete decoded passage content encoded as UTF-8, without normalization
encoding_and_ranges.ranges: Zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode code-point indexes in the decoded JSON string field or complete passage content, not UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 units or grapheme clusters.
encoding_and_ranges.literal_labels: Exercise labels separate from CitationCheck.result; invalid binding takes precedence over substring equality.
encoding_and_ranges.semantic_labels: AI-assisted provisional source/claim judgments for human review, separate from literal disposition.
encoding_and_ranges.not_replay_evidence: These authored fixed packets contain deliberately invalid claims/bindings. The recommendation, model_run times/zero tokens, IDs and versions are fixture metadata, not actual requests, invocations, decisions or reviewer signatures.
